title: HullQ Organization-BoatDesign Relationship v0.1
description: Standalone independently identifiable builder/manufacturer relationship between an Organization and a BoatDesign. Composes from relationship-applicability/0.1 for shared applicability fields and builder_role vocabulary. A builder change alone must not create a new BoatDesign (ADR-0004/ADR-0011).

organization_id.description: Reference to the Organization entity ID.

boat_design_id.description: Reference to the BoatDesign entity ID.

role.description: Builder/manufacturer role semantics for this relationship.
